content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Research group has developed and validated Bayesian hierarchical models and probabilistic reallocation methods to estimate spatial locations of records with incomplete or imprecise geocoding, achieving mean absolute errors of 3.1 to 3.4 per unit area in cross-validation studies.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-05819","field":"abstract","quote":"Bayesian CAR smoothing performed best overall (MAE 3.1 per 100,000), followed by weighted probabilistic reallocation (MAE 3.4)"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-05813","field":"abstract","quote":"empirical Bayes and fully Bayesian smoothing methods, multiple imputation of spatial location"}]},{"text":"Work addresses systematic spatial offsets and missing data in geographic asset registries through hierarchical geographic uncertainty frameworks that distinguish between different levels of location precision (settlement, street, coordinates).","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-05817","field":"abstract","quote":"hierarchical structure: a missing street address is known to lie within a settlement, which lies within a municipality"},{"id":"R0493","field":"bio","quote":"addressing incomplete or imprecise address geocoding that limits reliable incidence mapping"}]},{"text":"Expertise includes geostatistical smoothing, kriging, and spatial interpolation methods that generate confidence intervals and predictive performance assessments for sparse or uncertain spatial data using leave-one-out validation.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-05819","field":"abstract","quote":"kriging of standardised rates, and Bayesian CAR smoothing — using leave-one-out cross-validation"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-05813","field":"abstract","quote":"composite estimators that combine survey and registry information"}]}],"fit":"partial","fitReason":"The researcher's methods for probabilistic spatial imputation and Bayesian smoothing of incomplete geocoded data [SYN-PUB-05819, SYN-PUB-05817] address a neighbouring problem of locating point features in registries; however, the challenge requires active detection or real-time confidence mapping of buried cables rather than retrospective statistical imputation of historical records, and involves electromagnetic signal discrimination rather than geocoding correction."}
